coinflip-1to1.name: Coin Flip — 50/50 with 1:1 R:R
coinflip-1to1.description: Pure coin-flip baseline. No edge, just gambling. Use this to see how randomness alone behaves.

coinflip-2to1.name: Coin Flip — 50/50 with 2:1 R:R
coinflip-2to1.description: Coin-flip win rate but reward is 2× the risk. Strong edge from R:R alone.

scalp-aggressive.name: High win-rate scalper
scalp-aggressive.description: Scalper profile: wins often, but each win is small relative to loss. Vulnerable to losing streaks.

trend-follow.name: Trend follower
trend-follow.description: Classic trend-follow profile: low win rate, big winners. Long stretches of small losses, occasional home runs.

goshenfx-inspired.name: GoshenFX-inspired (5-bar breakout)
goshenfx-inspired.description: Modeled loosely on my own MQL5 breakout EAs: ATR stops, conservative position sizing, asymmetric R:R.

overconfident-trader.name: Overconfident trader
overconfident-trader.description: What happens when you risk too much per trade. Same edge as the trend-follower, but 5% per trade.

negative-edge.name: Negative-edge gambler
negative-edge.description: Slight house edge against you. Models what happens when fees and slippage tip a coin-flip into a losing system.
